ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark charcoal/black) base pixels occupying approximately 85% of the surface area, contrasted against localized high-intensity (white/tan) pixel clusters occupying approximately 15%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast tan and white circular blobs (approximate diameter 5-20 pixels) are distributed stochastically across the dark ventral surface of both lobes, with higher density in the mid-to-lower regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the central vertical axis with a depth approximately 1/4 the vertical height of the visible fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency sawtooth pattern along the entire trailing boundary; irregular peaks and valleys ranging from 5 to 30 pixels in amplitude relative to the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curvature initiating from the median notch and extending toward the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dozens of discrete, circular high-contrast clusters (barnacle attachments) varying in size, appearing as light-colored rings with darker centers against the black fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible in the lower-central and lower-right regions of the fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive colonization of parasitic barnacles across both lobes and associated white scarring patterns where previous attachments may have occurred.
other_distinctive_markers: The distal tips (corners) of both lobes exhibit highly irregular, ragged geometric profiles with deep secondary notches distinct from the primary trailing edge serrations.
